result.title: Two hidden layer suffice: the caterpillar net
result.comment: 17 pages. Lean formalization and paper sources: https://github.com/JayPiZimmermann/Max_Caterpillar
result.summary: Every continuous piecewise linear (CPWL) function is a finite signed sum of maxima of affine functions, making maximum representation a central problem in the study of the expressiveness of ReLU networks. A now-disproved conjecture predicted logarithmic depth for maxima. Inspired by the proof by Brunck et al. (2026) that two hidden layers suffice for general CPWL functions, we give the Caterpillar Net, a nonrecursive construction for the maximum of $N$ inputs with two hidden layers of widths $O(N^2)$ and $2^{O(N\log N)}$. The construction has a direct geometric interpretation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 ReLU 网络表达力，给出 Caterpillar Net：用两个隐藏层（宽度分别为 O(N²) 与 2^{O(N log N)}）非递归地构造 N 个输入的最大值，并附几何解释与 Lean 形式化。
AI.relevance_reason: 固定两层、非递归地表示 max 所付的宽度代价，可能为 latent 推理中递归／循环展开与硬选择（证据筛选、候选取舍）算子的表示成本提供参照线索，迁移性需核查。
